messages:
oncall-bot: SEV2 alert - continuous-batching latency spike & tail q backlog in us-east cluster. Error rate up 4x, 99p latency > 3s. Pager: @alex_v @sara_ops.

alex_v: seeing huge queue growth on cb-worker-xx. KV cache eviction rate spiking, mem reclaim loops. Starting triage.

sara_ops: confirmed. Visible when concurrency > 600 and avg seq len > 512. Microbatch sizes oscillating between 1 and 64. Likely jitter + batching threshold misfire.

mike_r: attaching recent logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T16:04:22Z] cb-worker-03 batch_size=1->64 jitter=20ms enqueue=450ms kv_evictions=720
[2026-03-15T16:04:23Z] perf: kv-regen-loop detected, inflight_queue=980, microbatch_fill=low
```

emily_s: customer impact: two mid-size tenants reporting 5-10s responses, one is failing streaming. Notified support.

samira: quick mitigation suggestion: force smaller max_microbatch, tighten jitter window, and enable fallback to non-continuous path for heavy tenants. Patch and roll to 10% first.

alex_v: agreed. I'm going to flip continuous_batch.max_microbatch from 64 -> 8 on us-east pool and set continuous_batch.jitter_ms = 8. Also enable cb_fallback for tenants with >50% error.

alex_v: hotfix (dry run) command run: `redwoodctl config set us-east continuous_batch.max_microbatch=8 continuous_batch.jitter_ms=8 cb_fallback.enabled=true --rollout 10%`

oncall-bot: Deploy job started: deploy/repair/3345001111 -> canary 10% -> track telemetry.

sara_ops: watching telemetry - enqueue depth started to decline at canary hosts. KV eviction rate down 60% on canary.

mike_r: adding safety throttle on request admission: `if inflight_queue > 700 then reject 503 with Retry-After` to avoid tail amplification. Pushing policy now.

emily_s: support update drafted: "We're mitigating a performance regression in our continuous batching layer; we've rolled a targeted hotspot patch, expect gradual recovery over next 15-30min. Contact support if you're still affected."

samira: after canary looks good, plan to roll to 50% -> 100% over 20m. Keep rollback plan ready.

alex_v: canary -> 50% rolled at +9m. Latency 99p dropped from 3.2s -> 0.9s on canary, overall cluster metrics improving.

oncall-bot: Incident timeline note created: 3345001111 - continuous-batch perf cliff mitigation.

emily_s: Customer impact: 3 tenants affected, 1 degraded streaming session, CS notified and postmortem will include customer outreach plan.

sara_ops: next steps: create follow-up runbook entries: - telemetry alert thresholds for kv_eviction_rate - admission-control backpressure knob - preferred cb parameter defaults for high-concurrency pools.

mike_r: root cause hypothesis: continuous batching heuristics allow large microbatches under bursty concurrency; jitter mechanism then creates oscillations that cause KV cache thrashing. Need longer-term: circuit that detects oscillatory fill patterns and forces deterministic microbatch caps per shard.

alex_v: assigning postmortem owners: samira (incident writeup), mike_r (root cause & fix), emily_s (customer comms).

oncall-bot: Handoff: Incident declared mitigated at 3345001390. No active pages.

sara_ops: leaving notes in runbook and paging policy. Good catch everyone :thumbsup:

mike_r: will open a follow-up PR with telemetry to detect microbatch variance and a safe default config change for Dedicated pools.

alex_v: marking thread resolved. If any regressions reappear ping this thread.
